Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
PIN, KNOWLES 



( Reaffirmed 2005 ) 



1. Scope — Dimensional and other requirements for Knowles pins used for internal fixation of hip 
bone in orthopaedic surgery. 

2- Shape and Dimensions ~ As shown in Fig. 1,

All dimensions in millimetres, 
FIG. 1 PIN, KNOWLES 

2-1 A deviation, of db 2'5 percent shall be applicable on all dimensions where not otherwise 
specified. 

2.2 The end point may be either conical or trocar. 

3. Material — Wrought stainless steel, wrought cobalt-chromium-tungsten-nickel alloy or unalloyed 
titanium in accordance with 3 of 15:5347-1979 'General requirements for metal surgical implants 
{first revision )\ The pins shall be in cold drawn condition. 

4. Workmanship and Finish 

4.1 The pin shall have an undercut as shown in Fig. 1 to facilitate cutting after fixation. 

4.2 The hexagonal nut shall be screwed and tight fitted in the pin. 

4.3 The pin shall be free from seams, laps, draw-marks, cracks, pits, etc. 

4.4 The piris shall be electropolished and passivated. 

5. Tests 

5.1 Corrosion Resistance Test — As per 6.1 of IS : 5347-1979. 

6. Marking — As per 5 of IS : 5347-1979. 

6.1 IS! Certification Marking — DeiaWs available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

7. Packing — As agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier.
